request: Fix set_key so values written in single-quoted form round-trip through dotenv_values(interpolate=False) without losing literal backslashes. Cover quote_mode='always' and the quoted branch of 'auto', including backslashes adjacent to quotes and at the end of values. Preserve existing quote_mode behavior, return values, export handling, encoding and all upstream tests. Do not change tests or broaden the requested API.
public_test:
import dotenv

def test_backslash_roundtrip(tmp_path):
    p = tmp_path / '.env'
    value = 'prefix' + chr(92) * 2 + 'tail'
    assert dotenv.set_key(p, 'A', value) == (True, 'A', value)
    assert dotenv.dotenv_values(p, interpolate=False)['A'] == value
hidden_test:
import dotenv
import pytest

@pytest.mark.parametrize('mode', ['always', 'auto'])
@pytest.mark.parametrize('value', [chr(92), chr(92)*3, 'x'+chr(92)+chr(39)+'y', chr(39)+chr(92)*2, 'é'+chr(92)*2+'z', 'two words'+chr(92)])
def test_roundtrip_variants(tmp_path, mode, value):
    p = tmp_path / 'case.env'
    p.write_text('OLD=keep\n', encoding='utf-8')
    assert dotenv.set_key(p, 'NEW', value, quote_mode=mode, export=True) == (True, 'NEW', value)
    values = dotenv.dotenv_values(p, interpolate=False)
    assert values['OLD'] == 'keep'
    assert values['NEW'] == value
